decision: Compare three untested openings. Existing clerk alone; names/contact details behind desk; existing two shelves/one cart only; daily preparation including corrections ≤10 clerk-minutes. Require ≥95% available pickups within two minutes and zero wrong-reader handoffs. All evidence synthetic. Household-delay causality, cart scaling and interview representativeness remain unknown; reader presence uncertainty remains unresolved.
